task.description: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) cross-checked all 11 of REQ-200's acceptance criteria in docs/requirements.yaml against ELIXIR-DEV's initial test pass in test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs's 'REQ-200 -- actor display name and description rendering' describe block. Full per-AC verdict recorded in handoffs/WF02-REQ200-20260830/test-designer-gap-analysis.md. Summary: AC1, AC4, AC5, AC6, AC7 were already completely and correctly covered (AC7's bound was tightened from <= 1 to == 1 to close a vacuous-pass risk, inline comment added explaining why). AC8 confirmed as 'existing REQ-080 tests still pass' with no new test needed (re-verified the four describe blocks that already cover its five named properties). AC9/AC10 confirmed as process/diff-scope claims (git diff --stat, already recorded by REVIEWER), not runtime tests -- none written, matching this role's own scope-test guidance against manufactured busywork. AC11 confirmed as a process requirement for TEST-RUNNER/already-run SECURITY-REVIEWER results, not a unit test. The one genuine gap was AC2: the requirement text explicitly requires 'four explicit tests' for the four fallback levels, but the initial pass proved all four (plus AC3's deleted-user case) in one combined test keyed by task_id. Replaced that single test with 5 independent tests -- one per AC2 level (each isolating only the inputs relevant to that level, e.g. passing actor_id: nil explicitly for levels 2-4 rather than an actor_id that merely fails to resolve) plus one dedicated to AC3 (genuinely creates then Repo.delete!s a user row, then references its id -- a real 'row existed, now gone' scenario, distinct from AC2 level 4's 'no actor_id at all'). Every assertion the original combined test made survives unchanged in content, just relocated -- nothing was weakened or removed. test/specs/REQ-200.md written per this role's Step 3 deliverable with the criterion, test case(s), and why-each-exists rationale for all 11 ACs. Every test (existing and new) uses its own TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1 with a unique slug_prefix -- no shared/global state, matching this file's established convention throughout. Did not run mix test myself (not this role's function) -- TEST-RUNNER runs next after this gate.
